neurons.label: Perceptual salience
neurons.definition: Relative sensory prominence created by feature contrast or conspicuity that biases competition for selection.

neurons.label: Stimulus-driven capture
neurons.definition: Involuntary prioritization caused by stimulus properties despite competing goals.

neurons.label: Orienting response
neurons.definition: Rapid reorientation of processing toward a newly prioritized stimulus or location.

neurons.label: Goal relevance
neurons.definition: Match between information and an active goal/task that raises selection priority.

neurons.label: Attentional set / target template
neurons.definition: Active representation of sought-for features or categories that biases selection.

neurons.label: Executive attentional control
neurons.definition: Top-down resolution of competition in favor of task-relevant processing.

neurons.label: Reward-associated attentional priority
neurons.definition: Learned attentional bias toward features previously associated with reward/value.

neurons.label: Prior-selection history
neurons.definition: Bias in current selection caused by prior selections independent of immediate goals.

neurons.label: Sustained attention
neurons.definition: Maintenance of task-relevant processing over extended time.
boundary_conditions: Sustained attention must not be inferred from initial hold/capture.

neurons.label: Vigilance decrement
neurons.definition: Time-related decline in sustained detection/monitoring performance.
neurons.measurement_route: within-task time-on-task decrement under a validated vigilance paradigm
boundary_conditions: A decrement is task-sensitive and not a stable trait by itself.

neurons.label: Attentional lapse
neurons.definition: Transient failure to maintain intended task-relevant processing.

neurons.label: Distractor suppression
neurons.definition: Active or learned down-weighting of irrelevant competing information.
boundary_conditions: Do not infer from low distraction alone; proactive and reactive suppression may need later split.

neurons.label: Attentional disengagement
neurons.definition: Release of processing priority from the currently attended target to enable reorientation.

neurons.label: Selection competition
neurons.definition: Concurrent competition among representations for limited processing priority.

neurons.label: Novelty appraisal
neurons.definition: Evaluation that information is new relative to current knowledge/history.

neurons.label: Surprise / expectancy violation
neurons.definition: Detection that an observation deviates from expectation and may warrant model updating.

neurons.label: Subjective uncertainty
neurons.definition: Experienced lack of confidence or unresolved state about information/outcomes.

neurons.label: Knowledge-gap representation
neurons.definition: Representation of a specific discrepancy between known and desired knowledge.

neurons.label: Expected information gain
neurons.definition: Anticipated reduction in uncertainty or improvement in knowledge from obtaining information.
boundary_conditions: Information gain is not identical to uncertainty magnitude.

neurons.label: Epistemic value
neurons.definition: Subjective value assigned to information itself, apart from immediate external reward.
neurons.measurement_route: information-choice valuation task or willingness-to-obtain information
boundary_conditions: Epistemic value must be distinguished from instrumental reward.

neurons.label: Learning-progress signal
neurons.definition: Perception that understanding or predictive competence is improving.
neurons.measurement_route: longitudinal/trial-level learning-progress estimate paired with exploration choice
boundary_conditions: Observed learning alone does not prove a subjective progress signal.

neurons.label: Competence-seeking
neurons.definition: Motivation to increase mastery or understanding through exploration.

neurons.label: Directed exploration
neurons.definition: Targeted sampling chosen because a specific information gap is expected to be resolved.

neurons.label: Exploratory information seeking
neurons.definition: Behavioral pursuit of additional information under uncertainty or novelty.

neurons.label: Threat-based information avoidance
neurons.definition: Avoidance of available information because anticipated knowledge is threatening or aversive.
boundary_conditions: Distinguish threat avoidance from simple lack of interest.

neurons.label: Effort/cost-based avoidance
neurons.definition: Avoidance because expected cognitive, temporal, monetary, or social costs outweigh information value.
boundary_conditions: Cost-based avoidance can coexist with curiosity.

neurons.label: Belief-protective avoidance
neurons.definition: Avoidance motivated by protecting identity, prior beliefs, or desired beliefs from disconfirming information.
neurons.measurement_route: information choice plus belief/identity relevance measures
boundary_conditions: Needs direct identity-protective disconfirmation evidence in later pass.

neurons.label: Subjective utility
neurons.definition: Context- and goal-dependent worth assigned to an option, outcome, or piece of information.

neurons.label: Personal relevance valuation
neurons.definition: Value increment/decrement arising because information bears on active needs, goals, or personally important concerns.

neurons.label: Subjective cost
neurons.definition: Perceived downside, effort, sacrifice, or opportunity cost attached to an option/action.

neurons.label: Expected outcome value
neurons.definition: Anticipated value of a future result before action or exposure.

neurons.label: Experienced outcome value
neurons.definition: Value assigned after an outcome is experienced.

neurons.label: Loss / punishment valuation
neurons.definition: Subjective negative value attached to anticipated or experienced adverse outcomes.

neurons.label: Goal-congruence appraisal
neurons.definition: Appraisal of whether an event supports or obstructs current goals.
boundary_conditions: One appraisal cannot identify an emotion by itself.

neurons.label: Certainty appraisal
neurons.definition: Appraisal of predictability/confidence about what is happening or will happen.
boundary_conditions: Certainty is distinct from confidence in source truth.

neurons.label: Control / coping-potential appraisal
neurons.definition: Appraisal of ability to influence, manage, or cope with an event.
boundary_conditions: Perceived control is context- and event-specific.

neurons.label: Agency / responsibility appraisal
neurons.definition: Appraisal of who or what caused or is responsible for an event.
boundary_conditions: Agency appraisal is not identical to moral blame.

neurons.label: Affective valence
neurons.definition: Positive-versus-negative subjective quality of affective experience.

neurons.label: Affective arousal
neurons.definition: Level of affective activation or physiological/subjective intensity.

neurons.label: Action activation
neurons.definition: General mobilization/readiness to act that is related to but not identical with arousal.

neurons.label: Differentiated positive emotion
neurons.definition: Specific positively valenced emotion state whose mechanisms/outcomes may differ from other positive emotions.

neurons.label: Differentiated negative emotion
neurons.definition: Specific negatively valenced emotion state whose mechanisms/outcomes may differ from other negative emotions.

neurons.label: Mixed emotion
neurons.definition: Co-occurring positive and negative affective experience that cannot be represented by one valence pole.

neurons.label: Approach tendency
neurons.definition: Readiness to move toward, engage with, or pursue an object/action.
boundary_conditions: Positive valence does not universally produce approach.

neurons.label: Avoidance / withdrawal tendency
neurons.definition: Readiness to disengage, withdraw, or avoid an object/action.
boundary_conditions: Negative valence does not universally produce avoidance.

neurons.label: Confrontation / mobilization tendency
neurons.definition: Readiness for active response or confrontation rather than passive withdrawal.

neurons.label: Personal self-concept
neurons.definition: Representation of attributes, roles, values, and narratives defining the individual self.

neurons.label: Self-relevance
neurons.definition: Degree to which information is interpreted as bearing on an important aspect of the self.

neurons.label: Identity centrality
neurons.definition: Importance of a particular identity component within the overall self-concept.

neurons.label: Self-categorization
neurons.definition: Momentary categorization of self as a member of a social category/group.

neurons.label: In-group identification
neurons.definition: Psychological attachment/identification with a social group.

neurons.label: Self-definition
neurons.definition: Perceived similarity/prototypicality and homogeneity that define the self in group terms.

neurons.label: Self-investment
neurons.definition: Importance, satisfaction, and solidarity invested in group membership.

neurons.label: Norm salience
neurons.definition: Accessibility of perceived group norms in the current context.
neurons.measurement_route: salient-group norm measure/manipulation with identification context
boundary_conditions: Norms should not be inferred from majority behavior alone.

neurons.label: Group prototypicality
neurons.definition: Perceived fit of a person/position with the defining prototype of the salient group.
neurons.measurement_route: group-prototypicality measure relative to a salient group/category
boundary_conditions: Prototypicality is group-relative, not generic similarity.

neurons.label: Identity threat appraisal
neurons.definition: Perception that a valued personal/social identity is challenged, devalued, or undermined.
boundary_conditions: Negative emotion alone is not identity threat.

neurons.label: Identity-protective response
neurons.definition: Cognitive/behavioral response oriented toward preserving or restoring a threatened identity.
neurons.measurement_route: coping/identity-protective response measure tied to threatened identity
boundary_conditions: Defense must be linked to identity restoration/protection mechanism.

neurons.label: Intergroup boundary maintenance
neurons.definition: Maintenance or sharpening of category boundaries distinguishing in-group from out-group.

neurons.label: Perceived integrity
neurons.definition: Belief that a source adheres to acceptable principles and is honest/non-deceptive.

neurons.label: Perceived benevolence
neurons.definition: Belief that a source has goodwill and is not primarily seeking to exploit the audience.

neurons.label: Perceived trustworthiness
neurons.definition: Integrated judgment that a source can be relied on in the relevant relationship/domain.

neurons.label: Perceived expertise
neurons.definition: Judgment that a source possesses relevant knowledge or experience.

neurons.label: Perceived competence
neurons.definition: Judgment that a source can perform/evaluate the relevant task accurately.

neurons.label: Perceived genuineness
neurons.definition: Judgment that presented identity/behavior is sincere rather than fabricated.
neurons.measurement_route: validated perceived-authenticity/genuineness measure matched to source context
boundary_conditions: Authenticity is not objective truth or universal engagement value.

neurons.label: Perceived motive authenticity
neurons.definition: Judgment that expressed motives/endorsements align with genuine beliefs rather than hidden incentives.

neurons.label: Behavioral consistency
neurons.definition: Perceived stability of source behavior/claims across repeated encounters.

neurons.label: Reliability track record
neurons.definition: Memory-based judgment from prior cases in which source claims/actions were dependable.

neurons.label: Source credibility cue use
neurons.definition: Heuristic use of credentials, verification badges, presentation, or source markers in credibility judgment.

neurons.label: Social credibility cue use
neurons.definition: Heuristic use of likes, follower counts, consensus, endorsements, or similar social signals.

neurons.label: Epistemic vigilance
neurons.definition: Monitoring for deception, error, weak evidence, or unreliable testimony before reliance.
boundary_conditions: Epistemic vigilance is not generalized skepticism.

neurons.label: Verification behavior
neurons.definition: Active checking of claims/source evidence against additional information.
boundary_conditions: Self-reported skepticism is not verification behavior.

neurons.label: Trust calibration
neurons.definition: Degree to which reliance changes appropriately with evidence of source reliability/accuracy.
neurons.measurement_route: calibration between reliance and known source reliability
boundary_conditions: High trust is not necessarily well-calibrated trust.

neurons.label: Parasocial interaction intensity
neurons.definition: Episode-level felt involvement or apparent interaction with a mediated persona.
neurons.measurement_route: episode-specific PSI measure such as EPSI when appropriate
boundary_conditions: Do not infer enduring relationship from within-exposure involvement.

neurons.label: Parasocial cognitive engagement
neurons.definition: Episode-level cognitive attention/elaboration directed toward the persona as a social partner.

neurons.label: Parasocial affective response
neurons.definition: Episode-level affective response toward the persona during mediated exposure.

neurons.label: Parasocial relational continuity
neurons.definition: Sense that the one-sided relationship persists across encounters.
neurons.measurement_route: PSR measure referring to enduring cross-episode relationship
boundary_conditions: Do not use PSI measure as a PSR substitute.

neurons.label: Parasocial relationship maintenance
neurons.definition: Motivation/behavior oriented toward maintaining continued one-sided relational contact.

neurons.label: Real-life relationship intention
neurons.definition: Desire or imagined intention for the mediated bond to become reciprocal/offline.
neurons.measurement_route: validated PSR dimension measuring real-life relationship intention
boundary_conditions: Desire for reciprocity is not evidence that reciprocity exists.

neurons.label: Creator familiarity
neurons.definition: Subjective recognition/knownness produced by repeated exposure to the same creator/source.

neurons.label: Exposure history representation
neurons.definition: Memory of frequency/recency/context of prior encounters with the creator/source.

neurons.label: Perceived relational closeness
neurons.definition: Subjective sense of psychological closeness to the creator/source.

neurons.label: Perceived intimacy
neurons.definition: Sense of personal/private knowing or emotional intimacy with the creator/source.
boundary_conditions: Intimacy must not be inferred from familiarity/exposure frequency.

neurons.label: Affective attachment
neurons.definition: Persistent emotional bond/investment toward the creator/source.

neurons.label: Separation / loss sensitivity
neurons.definition: Negative affect or concern triggered by perceived loss, absence, or disruption of the bond.

neurons.label: Share / forward action
neurons.definition: Observed act of transmitting content to another person or audience.

neurons.label: Sharing intention
neurons.definition: Stated or latent willingness to share, explicitly separate from observed action.

neurons.label: Recommendation action
neurons.definition: Observed endorsement/recommendation of content, source, product, or idea.

neurons.label: Word-of-mouth evaluation
neurons.definition: Positive, negative, or mixed evaluative communication communicated to others.

neurons.label: Perceived recipient usefulness
neurons.definition: Belief that shared information will help, inform, or benefit the recipient.
neurons.measurement_route: recipient-usefulness appraisal tied to a specific sharing decision
boundary_conditions: Usefulness is a motive/appraisal, not the share action itself.

neurons.label: Information-value sharing motive
neurons.definition: Motivation to transmit because content is considered informative or practically valuable.
boundary_conditions: Information-value motive may coexist with other motives.

neurons.label: Identity-signaling motive
neurons.definition: Motivation to transmit content to communicate group membership, values, or self-definition.

neurons.label: Impression-management motive
neurons.definition: Motivation to shape how the audience perceives the sender.
boundary_conditions: Cannot infer motive from share action alone.

neurons.label: Affective-expression motive
neurons.definition: Motivation to externalize or communicate emotional experience through sharing.

neurons.label: Emotion-regulation motive
neurons.definition: Motivation to share as a way to regulate, process, amplify, or reduce emotion.
neurons.measurement_route: emotion-regulation motive measure linked to transmission choice
boundary_conditions: Keep separate from incidental arousal.

neurons.label: Privacy-cost appraisal
neurons.definition: Expected privacy cost or unwanted information exposure associated with transmission.
neurons.measurement_route: privacy-risk/cost appraisal tied to audience and disclosure context
boundary_conditions: Privacy concern may not translate directly to behavior in every context.

neurons.label: Reputational-risk appraisal
neurons.definition: Expected social-image/reputation harm from transmitting content to a given audience.
boundary_conditions: Reputational risk is audience-dependent and distinct from privacy risk.

neurons.label: Audience-inhibition signal
neurons.definition: Reduction in willingness to transmit due to who may see the communication.

neurons.label: Social-bonding motive
neurons.definition: Motivation to share to create or strengthen interpersonal connection.
boundary_conditions: Sharing may have multiple simultaneous motives.

neurons.label: Relationship-maintenance motive
neurons.definition: Motivation to communicate/share to sustain an existing relationship over time.

neurons.label: Reward prediction error
neurons.definition: Difference between expected and experienced outcome value used for learning/updating.

neurons.label: Outcome-value updating
neurons.definition: Revision of expected action/cue value from experienced outcomes.

neurons.label: Reinforcement sensitivity
neurons.definition: Individual/contextual sensitivity to reward/punishment signals during learning.

neurons.label: Context-response association strength
neurons.definition: Learned strength linking a recurring context/cue to a behavioral response.

neurons.label: Cue-triggered response tendency
neurons.definition: Tendency for a contextual cue to activate a learned response.

neurons.label: Automaticity
neurons.definition: Degree to which a response is initiated/executed with reduced deliberation.

neurons.label: Outcome insensitivity
neurons.definition: Persistence of a response despite reduced current value of the outcome, where demonstrated.

neurons.label: Habitual control strength
neurons.definition: Relative control exerted by context-response mechanisms over current behavior.

neurons.label: Action-outcome representation
neurons.definition: Representation linking an action to expected consequences used in goal-directed control.
neurons.measurement_route: action-outcome knowledge or model-based transition/outcome representation task
boundary_conditions: Model-based metrics are approximations, not literal proof of a single neural system.

neurons.label: Goal-directed control strength
neurons.definition: Degree to which current goals/outcome values guide action selection.
neurons.measurement_route: goal-directed sensitivity to current outcome values/action-outcome contingencies
boundary_conditions: Goal-directed control can coexist with habitual influences.

neurons.label: Habit–goal arbitration
neurons.definition: Competition/integration determining whether habitual or goal-directed control dominates.

neurons.label: Behavior repetition
neurons.definition: Repeated performance of an action, treated as an input to habit formation rather than habit itself.
boundary_conditions: Repetition is input/history, not habit diagnosis.

neurons.label: Context stability
neurons.definition: Consistency of contextual cues across repeated performance episodes.
boundary_conditions: Context must be defined behavior-specifically.

neurons.label: Habit formation trajectory
neurons.definition: Change in automatic/context-triggered control across repeated stable-context practice.
boundary_conditions: No universal formation duration.

neurons.label: Context discontinuity
neurons.definition: Change/removal of cues that reduces retrieval of a previously learned habitual response.
boundary_conditions: Context change is an opportunity, not guaranteed behavior change.

neurons.label: Contingency / outcome revaluation
neurons.definition: Change in consequences or action-outcome contingencies that can reveal or alter control mode.

neurons.label: Habit suppression / override
neurons.definition: Successful inhibition or replacement of a prepotent habitual response under changed goals/context.
